messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take Meloxicam exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Use the lowest effective dose for your condition.
Meloxicam oral is taken by mouth.
Meloxicam injection (Qamzova, Xifyrm) is given as an intravenous bolus injection over 15 seconds.
A healthcare provider will give you this injection.
Your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of meloxicam.
Avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes.
Meloxicam doses are based on weight (especially in children and teenagers).
Your dose needs may change if you gain or lose weight.
If you use this medicine long-term, you may need frequent medical tests.
Store oral suspension, tablets, or capsules at room temperature, away from moisture and heat.
Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use.
Triplet: ["meloxicam injection", "administered by", "healthcare provider"]

The relation 'administered by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is administered by the healthcare professional or entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
B. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
